C158.name: Njombe Town Council
C158.documented: heavy rain and cold on the southern highlands, strong winds, and valley floods

area.en: Njombe Town: highland town and plantation edges
area.sw: Mji wa Njombe: mji wa nyanda za juu na pembezoni mwa mashamba ya miti

risk.en: This area is a cold, wet highland town surrounded by pine and wattle plantations, where dry-season fires spread from plantations and heavy rain floods valley streets.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa nyanda za juu wenye baridi na unyevu uliozungukwa na mashamba ya misindano na miwattle, ambapo moto wa kiangazi husambaa kutoka mashambani na mvua kubwa hufurika mitaa ya mabondeni.

advice.en: For those living and working here, it helps to keep fire breaks around homes and sawmills, keep drains open and keep warm in cold spells, especially children and older people. What raises the risk: letting sawdust and off-cuts pile against walls, burning rubbish on windy days, blocking the drains and leaving infants and the elderly in unheated rooms on frosty nights. Know the cleared open ground your household will move to if a plantation fire comes towards the houses, and move when smoke or flames are seen on the plantation edge; on cold nights, check on older neighbours who live alone. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya kazi hapa, ni vyema kuweka njia za kuzuia moto kuzunguka nyumba na viwanda vya mbao, kuweka mitaro wazi na kujikinga na baridi kali, hasa watoto na wazee. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuacha mabaki ya mbao yarundikane kwenye kuta, kuchoma taka siku za upepo, kuziba mitaro na kuwaacha watoto wachanga na wazee kwenye vyumba visivyo na joto usiku wa baridi kali. Fahamu uwanja wazi uliosafishwa ambao kaya yako itahamia moto wa msituni ukielekea nyumbani, na ondokeni moshi au miale ikionekana mpakani mwa msitu; usiku wa baridi, wajulieni hali majirani wazee wanaoishi peke yao. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C159.name: Makambako Town Council
C159.documented: heavy rain, strong winds, and floods on the highland valleys

area.en: Makambako Town: TAZARA and highway junction
area.sw: Mji wa Makambako: makutano ya TAZARA na barabara kuu

risk.en: This area is a windy transport junction on the TANZAM highway and TAZARA railway, where heavy traffic brings accident and fuel-fire risk and storms damage roofs.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni makutano yenye upepo ya barabara kuu ya TANZAM na reli ya TAZARA, ambapo magari mengi huleta hatari ya ajali na moto wa mafuta na dhoruba huharibu paa.

advice.en: For those trading and travelling here, it helps to trade outside the road reserve, keep fire extinguishers at fuel stations and markets and fix roofs firmly. What raises the risk: trading, parking and building inside the road reserve, storing fuel in homes and shops, and leaving roofs loosely fixed in this windy junction. Know the open ground away from the fuel stations and the highway that traders will move to if a fuel fire or tanker crash happens, and clear it at once when told; when a strong-wind warning is given, secure stalls and roofs before the wind arrives. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaofanya biashara na kusafiri hapa, ni vyema kufanya biashara nje ya hifadhi ya barabara, kuweka vizimamoto kwenye vituo vya mafuta na masoko na kufunga paa imara. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufanya biashara, kuegesha na kujenga ndani ya hifadhi ya barabara, kuhifadhi mafuta majumbani na madukani, na kuacha paa zisizofungwa imara kwenye makutano haya yenye upepo. Fahamu uwanja wazi mbali na vituo vya mafuta na barabara kuu ambao wafanyabiashara watahamia moto wa mafuta au ajali ya lori la mafuta ikitokea, na ondokeni mara moja mnapoambiwa; tahadhari ya upepo mkali ikitolewa, fungeni vibanda na paa kabla upepo haujafika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C160.name: Ludewa District Council
C160.documented: Lake Nyasa floods and large waves, heavy rain, landslides, and boat accidents

area.en: Ludewa: Livingstone mountains and Lake Nyasa shore
area.sw: Ludewa: milima ya Livingstone na ufukwe wa Ziwa Nyasa

risk.en: This area has the steep Livingstone escarpment, where landslides and washouts cut remote roads, and Lake Nyasa shore villages exposed to sudden lake storms.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mteremko mkali wa milima ya Livingstone, ambapo maporomoko na kusombwa kwa barabara hukata barabara za mbali, na vijiji vya ufukwe wa Ziwa Nyasa vinavyoathiriwa na dhoruba za ghafla ziwani.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to build away from steep cuts and stream banks, wear life jackets and keep food and medicine reserves in remote villages. What raises the risk: cutting plots into the escarpment, building on stream banks, setting out on the lake in loaded boats when the sky is building, and letting village food and medicine stocks run out before the roads close. Know the firm ground away from the cuts and streams that your household will move to when heavy rain sets in on the mountains, and the sheltered landing boats will run to when a lake storm builds; restock the village before the rains, because the road may be cut for weeks. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na miinuko mikali na kingo za vijito, kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa na kuweka akiba ya chakula na dawa vijijini vya mbali. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchonga viwanja kwenye mwinuko, kujenga kwenye kingo za vijito, kutoka ziwani kwa vyombo vilivyojaa anga linapojengeka, na kuacha akiba za chakula na dawa za kijiji ziishe kabla barabara hazijafungwa. Fahamu eneo imara mbali na miinuko na vijito ambalo kaya yako itahamia mvua kubwa inapoanza milimani, na mwalo uliokingwa ambao vyombo vitakimbilia dhoruba ya ziwa inapojengeka; jazeni akiba kijijini kabla ya mvua, kwa sababu barabara inaweza kufungwa kwa wiki. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C161.name: Makete District Council
C161.documented: heavy rain, landslides on the Kipengere slopes, strong winds, and cold

area.sw: Makete: vijiji vya milimani vyenye baridi kali

risk.en: This area is very high, cold mountain country where frost and hail damage crops, steep slopes slide in heavy rain and roads close in the rains.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni nchi ya milima mirefu sana yenye baridi kali ambapo barafu na mvua ya mawe huharibu mazao, miteremko mikali huporomoka wakati wa mvua kubwa na barabara hufungwa wakati wa mvua.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep terraces and trees on slopes, plant frost-tolerant crops and keep warm clothing and food reserves. What raises the risk: opening new fields on the steepest slopes, cutting into the slope behind a house, relying on one frost-prone crop and leaving the old and the very young unprotected on cold nights. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope, and move there when cracks open or water runs muddy during heavy rain; before the roads close for the rains, make sure the household has food, fuel and medicine to last. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kutunza matuta na miti kwenye miteremko, kupanda mazao yanayostahimili baridi na kuweka nguo za joto na akiba ya chakula. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufungua mashamba mapya kwenye miteremko mikali zaidi, kuchimba mteremko nyuma ya nyumba, kutegemea zao moja linaloathiriwa na baridi na kuwaacha wazee na watoto wadogo bila kinga usiku wa baridi. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko, na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka au maji yakitiririka ya matope wakati wa mvua kubwa; kabla barabara hazijafungwa kwa mvua, hakikisheni kaya ina chakula, kuni na dawa za kutosha. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C157.name: Njombe District Council
C157.documented: heavy rain, landslides, valley floods, and strong winds

area.en: Njombe DC: highland farms and plantations
area.sw: Njombe DC: mashamba ya nyanda za juu na misitu ya kupandwa

risk.en: This area has highland farms and tree plantations where dry-season fires spread fast, frost damages crops and heavy rain erodes slopes.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya nyanda za juu na misitu ya kupandwa ambapo moto wa kiangazi husambaa haraka, barafu huharibu mazao na mvua kubwa humomonyoa miteremko.

advice.en: For those farming here, it helps to burn fields only under control on calm days, keep fire breaks around plantations and keep slopes planted. What raises the risk: burning fields on windy days or late in the dry season, leaving fires unattended, planting trees right up to the houses and clearing slopes bare. Know the cleared open ground your household will move to if a plantation fire comes towards the houses, and move when smoke is seen on the plantation edge; report any fire to the village leaders at once. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima hapa, ni vyema kuchoma mashamba kwa udhibiti siku zisizo na upepo tu, kuweka njia za kuzuia moto kuzunguka misitu na kuacha mimea kwenye miteremko. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchoma mashamba siku za upepo au mwishoni mwa kiangazi, kuacha moto bila uangalizi, kupanda miti hadi karibu na nyumba na kusafisha miteremko hadi kuwa tupu. Fahamu uwanja wazi uliosafishwa ambao kaya yako itahamia moto wa msituni ukielekea nyumbani, na ondokeni moshi ukionekana mpakani mwa msitu; ripoti moto wowote kwa viongozi wa kijiji mara moja. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C162.name: Wanging'ombe District Council
C162.documented: heavy rain, valley floods, and strong winds on the plateau

area.sw: Wanging'ombe: tambarare za nyanda za juu na ardhioevu

risk.en: This area has open highland plains where strong winds and hail damage crops and roofs, wetlands that flood in heavy rains and dry spells that reduce harvests.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina tambarare za wazi za nyanda za juu ambapo upepo mkali na mvua ya mawe huharibu mazao na paa, ardhioevu inayofurika wakati wa mvua kubwa na vipindi vya ukavu vinavyopunguza mavuno.

advice.en: For those farming here, it helps to plant windbreaks, fix roofs firmly, keep homes off wetland margins and keep household food reserves. What raises the risk and to the loss in a dry year: building on the wetland margin, leaving roofs loosely fixed on the open plain, and selling the whole harvest at once. Know the higher ground your household will move to when the wetlands spread in heavy rain, and get children and animals under a solid roof early when hail or a storm is forecast. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima hapa, ni vyema kupanda mistari ya miti ya kuzuia upepo, kufunga paa imara, kujenga nje ya kingo za ardhioevu na kuweka akiba ya chakula ya kaya. Kinachoongeza hatari na hasara mwaka wa ukame: kujenga kwenye kingo za ardhioevu, kuacha paa zisizofungwa imara kwenye tambarare wazi, na kuuza mavuno yote kwa mara moja. Fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia ardhioevu inapotanuka wakati wa mvua kubwa, na waweke watoto na mifugo chini ya paa imara mapema mvua ya mawe au dhoruba ikitabiriwa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
